#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#include <cstring>
using namespace std;

class InputReader {
public:
    istream& is;
    vector<unsigned char> buf;
    int pos;
    int size;

    InputReader(istream& is) : is(is), buf(1024), pos(0), size(0) {}

    int nextInt() {
        int c = read();
        while (isWhitespace(c))
            c = read();
        int sign = 1;
        if (c == '-') {
            sign = -1;
            c = read();
        }
        int res = 0;
        do {
            if (c < '0' || c > '9')
                throw runtime_error("Input mismatch");
            res = res * 10 + c - '0';
            c = read();
        } while (!isWhitespace(c));
        return res * sign;
    }

private:
    int read() {
        if (size == -1)
            throw runtime_error("Input mismatch");
        if (pos >= size) {
            pos = 0;
            size = is.readsome(reinterpret_cast<char*>(buf.data()), buf.size());
            if (size <= 0)
                return -1;
        }
        return buf[pos++] & 255;
    }

    static bool isWhitespace(int c) {
        return c == ' ' || c == '\n' || c == '\r' || c == '\t' || c == -1;
    }
};

vector<int> multiplyMod(const vector<int>& a, const vector<int>& b, int mod) {
    int need = a.size() + b.size() - 1;
    int n = max(2, 1 << (32 - __builtin_clz(need - 1)));
    
    vector<double> aReal(n, 0.0);
    vector<double> aImaginary(n, 0.0);
    for (int i = 0; i < (int)a.size(); i++) {
        int x = ((a[i] % mod) + mod) % mod;
        aReal[i] = x & ((1 << 15) - 1);
        aImaginary[i] = x >> 15;
    }
    
    // FFT on a
    for (int i = 1; i < n; i++) {
        int j = __builtin_bitreverse32(i) >> (32 - __builtin_ctz(n));
        if (i < j) {
            swap(aReal[i], aReal[j]);
            swap(aImaginary[i], aImaginary[j]);
        }
    }
    
    for (int len = 2; len <= n; len <<= 1) {
        int halfLen = len >> 1;
        vector<double> cs(halfLen);
        vector<double> sn(halfLen);
        for (int i = 0; i < halfLen; i++) {
            cs[i] = cos(2 * M_PI * i / len);
            sn[i] = sin(2 * M_PI * i / len);
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i += len) {
            for (int j = 0; j < halfLen; j++) {
                double wA = cs[j];
                double wB = sn[j];
                
                double uA = aReal[i + j];
                double uB = aImaginary[i + j];
                double vA = aReal[i + j + halfLen] * wA - aImaginary[i + j + halfLen] * wB;
                double vB = aReal[i + j + halfLen] * wB + aImaginary[i + j + halfLen] * wA;
                aReal[i + j] = uA + vA;
                aImaginary[i + j] = uB + vB;
                aReal[i + j + halfLen] = uA - vA;
                aImaginary[i + j + halfLen] = uB - vB;
            }
        }
    }
    
    vector<double> bReal(n, 0.0);
    vector<double> bImaginary(n, 0.0);
    if (a == b) {
        copy(aReal.begin(), aReal.end(), bReal.begin());
        copy(aImaginary.begin(), aImaginary.end(), bImaginary.begin());
    } else {
        for (int i = 0; i < (int)b.size(); i++) {
            int x = ((b[i] % mod) + mod) % mod;
            bReal[i] = x & ((1 << 15) - 1);
            bImaginary[i] = x >> 15;
        }
        
        // FFT on b
        for (int i = 1; i < n; i++) {
            int j = __builtin_bitreverse32(i) >> (32 - __builtin_ctz(n));
            if (i < j) {
                swap(bReal[i], bReal[j]);
                swap(bImaginary[i], bImaginary[j]);
            }
        }
        
        for (int len = 2; len <= n; len <<= 1) {
            int halfLen = len >> 1;
            vector<double> cs(halfLen);
            vector<double> sn(halfLen);
            for (int i = 0; i < halfLen; i++) {
                cs[i] = cos(2 * M_PI * i / len);
                sn[i] = sin(2 * M_PI * i / len);
            }
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i += len) {
                for (int j = 0; j < halfLen; j++) {
                    double wA = cs[j];
                    double wB = sn[j];
                    
                    double uA = bReal[i + j];
                    double uB = bImaginary[i + j];
                    double vA = bReal[i + j + halfLen] * wA - bImaginary[i + j + halfLen] * wB;
                    double vB = bReal[i + j + halfLen] * wB + bImaginary[i + j + halfLen] * wA;
                    bReal[i + j] = uA + vA;
                    bImaginary[i + j] = uB + vB;
                    bReal[i + j + halfLen] = uA - vA;
                    bImaginary[i + j + halfLen] = uB - vB;
                }
            }
        }
    }
    
    vector<double> faReal(n, 0.0);
    vector<double> faImaginary(n, 0.0);
    vector<double> fbReal(n, 0.0);
    vector<double> fbImaginary(n, 0.0);
    
    double cf = 0.25 / n;
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        int j = (n - i) & (n - 1);
        
        double a1r = (aReal[i] + aReal[j]);
        double a1i = (aImaginary[i] - aImaginary[j]);
        double a2r = (aImaginary[i] + aImaginary[j]);
        double a2i = (aReal[j] - aReal[i]);
        
        double b1r = (bReal[i] + bReal[j]) * cf;
        double b1i = (bImaginary[i] - bImaginary[j]) * cf;
        double b2r = (bImaginary[i] + bImaginary[j]) * cf;
        double b2i = (bReal[j] - bReal[i]) * cf;
        
        faReal[i] = a1r * b1r - a1i * b1i - a2r * b2i - a2i * b2r;
        faImaginary[i] = a1r * b1i + a1i * b1r + a2r * b2r - a2i * b2i;
        
        fbReal[i] = a1r * b2r - a1i * b2i + a2r * b1r - a2i * b1i;
        fbImaginary[i] = a1r * b2i + a1i * b2r + a2r * b1i + a2i * b1r;
    }
    
    // Inverse FFT on fa
    for (int i = 1; i < n; i++) {
        int j = __builtin_bitreverse32(i) >> (32 - __builtin_ctz(n));
        if (i < j) {
            swap(faReal[i], faReal[j]);
            swap(faImaginary[i], faImaginary[j]);
        }
    }
    
    for (int len = 2; len <= n; len <<= 1) {
        int halfLen = len >> 1;
        vector<double> cs(halfLen);
        vector<double> sn(halfLen);
        for (int i = 0; i < halfLen; i++) {
            cs[i] = cos(2 * M_PI * i / len * -1);
            sn[i] = sin(2 * M_PI * i / len * -1);
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i += len) {
            for (int j = 0; j < halfLen; j++) {
                double wA = cs[j];
                double wB = sn[j];
                
                double uA = faReal[i + j];
                double uB = faImaginary[i + j];
                double vA = faReal[i + j + halfLen] * wA - faImaginary[i + j + halfLen] * wB;
                double vB = faReal[i + j + halfLen] * wB + faImaginary[i + j + halfLen] * wA;
                faReal[i + j] = uA + vA;
                faImaginary[i + j] = uB + vB;
                faReal[i + j + halfLen] = uA - vA;
                faImaginary[i + j + halfLen] = uB - vB;
            }
        }
    }
    
    // Inverse FFT on fb
    for (int i = 1; i < n; i++) {
        int j = __builtin_bitreverse32(i) >> (32 - __builtin_ctz(n));
        if (i < j) {
            swap(fbReal[i], fbReal[j]);
            swap(fbImaginary[i], fbImaginary[j]);
        }
    }
    
    for (int len = 2; len <= n; len <<= 1) {
        int halfLen = len >> 1;
        vector<double> cs(halfLen);
        vector<double> sn(halfLen);
        for (int i = 0; i < halfLen; i++) {
            cs[i] = cos(2 * M_PI * i / len * -1);
            sn[i] = sin(2 * M_PI * i / len * -1);
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i += len) {
            for (int j = 0; j < halfLen; j++) {
                double wA = cs[j];
                double wB = sn[j];
                
                double uA = fbReal[i + j];
                double uB = fbImaginary[i + j];
                double vA = fbReal[i + j + halfLen] * wA - fbImaginary[i + j + halfLen] * wB;
                double vB = fbReal[i + j + halfLen] * wB + fbImaginary[i + j + halfLen] * wA;
                fbReal[i + j] = uA + vA;
                fbImaginary[i + j] = uB + vB;
                fbReal[i + j + halfLen] = uA - vA;
                fbImaginary[i + j + halfLen] = uB - vB;
            }
        }
    }
    
    vector<int> res(need, 0);
    for (int i = 0; i < need; i++) {
        long long aa = llround(faReal[i]);
        long long bb = llround(fbReal[i]);
        long long cc = llround(faImaginary[i]);
        res[i] = (int)((aa + ((bb % mod) << 15) + ((cc % mod) << 30)) % mod);
    }
    
    return res;
}

void solve() {
    int mod = 998244353;
    int n, k;
    cin >> n >> k;
    vector<int> v(10, 0);
    for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) {
        int x;
        cin >> x;
        v[x] = 1;
    }
    vector<int> ans = {1};
    int p = n / 2;
    while (true) {
        if (p % 2 != 0) {
            ans = multiplyMod(ans, v, mod);
        }
        p /= 2;
        if (p == 0) break;
        v = multiplyMod(v, v, mod);
    }
    int res = 0;
    for (int x : ans) {
        res = (int)((res + (long long)x * x) % mod);
    }
    cout << res << endl;
}

int main() {
    solve();
